description: This source file contains unit tests for the SystemAudioPlayer plugin, implemented using Google Test framework. It tests various functionalities such as opening, configuring, playing, pausing, stopping, and querying the status of audio playback sessions, specifically tailored for different audio types, source types, and play modes. The tests validate correct behaviors, error handling, and boundary conditions.

classes.name: SAPTest
classes.description: Base test fixture for SystemAudioPlayer, setting up common components like plugin, handler, connection, and worker pool.

classes.name: SAPInitializedTest
classes.description: Derived fixture that initializes the plugin and various mocks before each test, and deinitializes after.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Creates the SystemAudioPlayer plugin instance for testing.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases resources and mocks after tests complete.
